title: RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Using pBIOZOL-LiCl Method
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4rvgv66
materials: Grind tissue to a powder in liquid nitrogen.
Before library construction, treat RNA with DNase I.

steps.title: Initial RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1.3 mL of cold (4 °C) pBIOZOL reagent to up to 100 mg of frozen, ground tissue.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 5 minutes at room temperature, laying the tube horizontally to maximize surface area.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 minutes
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 ml RNase-free tube

steps.title: Precipitation with NaAc
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 2 M NaAc (pH 4.2) to the extract.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 4 °C for 10 minutes to separate the phases

steps.title: LiCl Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1/3 volume of 10 M LiCl to the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 4 °C for 20 minutes
Decant the supernatant, ensuring the pellet is not lost
Centrifuge at 4 °C for 3 minutes
Repeat the decanting and 3-minute centrifugation steps

steps.title: RNA Dissolution and SSTE Buffer Addition
steps.instruction: Dissolve the RNA pellet by adding 50 µL RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Add SSTE buffer to the RNA to reach a total volume of 600 µL
Vortex the tube until the phases mix and appear cloudy
Centrifuge in a microcentrifuge for 10 minutes
Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new 1.5 ml RNase-free tube

steps.title: Secondary Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube until the phases mix and appear cloudy.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 minutes
Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new 1.5 ml RNase-free tube
Centrifuge at 4 °C for 20 minutes

steps.title: Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 75% ethanol to the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C for 5 minutes
Repeat the ethanol addition and centrifugation steps
Open the cap and air-dry the pellet for no more than 5 minutes

steps.title: Pellet Dissolution and Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet by adding 30 µL RNase-free water and mix by briefly vortexing or flicking the bottom of the tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL 5 M NaCl and 300 µL chloroform
Vortex vigorously
Transfer the top aqueous phase (approximately 400 µL – 500 µL) to a new 1.5 ml RNase-free tube

steps.title: Overnight Incubation and Final Precipitation
steps.instruction: Mix the sample and let it stand at 4 °C overnight.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 75% ethanol to the pellet
Stand the tube at room temperature for 3 minutes
Decant the liquid carefully to avoid losing the pellet
Briefly centrifuge to collect residual liquid and remove it with a pipette
Pipette the water up and down over the pellet to dissolve the RNA (combine extractions if more than 100 mg tissue was used)

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Purification
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 25:24:1 acid phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to the tube.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 24:1 chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to the tube

steps.title: Final RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Add the following to the aqueous phase: 2 volumes of 100% ethanol, 1/10 volume of 3 M NaAc (pH 5.2), and 2 µL 5 mg/ml glycogen.

substeps.instruction: Store at -20 °C for 2 hours
Decant the supernatant carefully to avoid losing the pellet
Incubate at 20 °C for 3 minutes
Decant the liquid carefully to avoid losing the pellet
Briefly centrifuge to collect residual liquid and remove it with a pipette
